user.title: Sunrise
user.description: Adds agent skills and a set of tools for your own AI agent, served through Home Assistant's MCP Server as the "Sunrise" API. Everything stays on your home network.

init.title: Sunrise
init.description: Sunrise only switches what you've exposed to voice assistants (Settings > Voice assistants > Expose), the same as Assist.

data.read_unexposed: Let Sunrise look at things that aren't exposed

data_description.read_unexposed: Read only, to explain why something stopped working. Turn off to keep Sunrise to exposed things entirely.
